queries.Users:
SELECT 
u.[Id],
u.[Login],
u.[FirstName],
u.[LastName],
u.[IsAdmin],
p.[Email]
FROM @{item().SchemaName}.@{item().tableName} u
OUTER APPLY (
SELECT TOP 1 
      p.[Email]
FROM 
      MDM_Mirror_Person p
WHERE 
      p.ActiveDirectoryAccount = u.Login)p;
